adjustment_method_disposition.agm_or_other: Review source subject and issuer filing before classification.
adjustment_method_disposition.bonus: Verify source ratio semantics and issuer notice before calculating a factor; not applied.
adjustment_method_disposition.buyback: No mechanical price factor; keep as a separately dated event feature.
adjustment_method_disposition.dividend: Needs previous raw close and confirmed cash amount; candidate factor (previous_close-cash)/previous_close; not calculated.
adjustment_method_disposition.merger_demerger: No generic scaling or cross-security stitching; exclude affected cycles until scheme terms are verified.
adjustment_method_disposition.rights: TERP requires entitlement ratio and subscription price; manual review required.
adjustment_method_disposition.split: Check face_value_to/face_value_from against issuer/exchange notice; not applied.
adjustment_method_disposition.unclassified: Unknown event class; affected windows remain unresolved.

limitations: Discovery catalogue only; no adjustment factors calculated or applied.
Source-reported ISIN may be stale across restructurings; symbol/date matching is not proof of identity.
Rights, mergers, demergers, buybacks and unclassified actions need event-specific handling.
Independent exchange/issuer circular review is still required.
TejHQ terms do not grant exchange-data rights; exchange terms apply independently.

source.license_scope: PERSONAL_USE_ONLY; no client/business use; no raw redistribution; exchange terms apply independently
